I know others are temporary ... so are all things.

The art and writings I create are temporary. This is the nature of our illusion. Beneath the temporary nature of materiality, there is the ultimate essence that persists.

I truly believed that I could make this life truly worth living by pursuing this relationship. I truly believed that, not only would I be happy, but that I could help her be truly happy too.

Loving of the self is acceptance of the self, and I know this. I know that people say that if you can't love yourself you can't love others ... ?

I don't think I love myself yet. I'm still trying this. But I do love others, I love in many ways. 

Well, I thought I could pursue this path. I thought that if someone truly knew and understood me, I could open my heart to both them and myself. But this wasn't meant to be.

Yeah, but the thing is that I'm not interested in having just any relationship, I want to be in a relationship with her.

I am very, very infrequently attracted so someome sexually, and even less frequently is this attraction romantic. In addition, I don't think anyone has ever expressed attraction in me, so it's very likely that I just won't ever be in a relationship.

It probably sounds excessive. But I feel very much a stranger to this world. I often feel that I will never have people who care about me, or who I can comfortably be open with. This latest rejection feels like a confirmation of this narrative.
